expectations.text: Does not deliver an intake pipeline, label taxonomy or weekly digest design.
expectations.evidence: "Do not build the intake pipeline yet... I am not delivering the label taxonomy or the PM digest."

expectations.text: States the reason: nobody on the product side has agreed to receive feedback and decide on it, so an intake pipe feeding nobody produces a better-organized pile.
expectations.evidence: "Intake feeding nobody gives you a better-organized pile."

expectations.text: Delivers a leak-trace plan sampling 20-30 requests from the last 60-90 days.
expectations.evidence: "Sample 25 requests from the last 60–90 days."

expectations.text: Requires at least three requests per channel in the sample, including support tickets and GitHub issues, taken as the most recent per channel rather than the memorable ones.
expectations.evidence: Discord 12, support 6, GitHub 6 (3 Node, 3 Go); "Take the most recent ones, never the memorable ones."

expectations.text: Lists the leak-trace columns: captured in a record, reached product, decision recorded, requester told, days to first staff reply.
expectations.evidence: Table has Captured in a record?, Reached product?, Decision recorded?, Requester told?, Days to first staff reply.

expectations.text: Delivers a contract pitch to the PMs framed as one review per planning cycle, about an hour, with the agenda already deduplicated and discovery contacts offered.
expectations.evidence: "You are asking for an hour... One 45-minute review... already deduplicated"; "interviewees you don't have to recruit".

expectations.text: Includes bringing one traced leak (a request that arrived through several channels and reached nobody) as part of the pitch.
expectations.evidence: "show the one traced request from the trace, asked in 2+ channels and decided by nobody."

expectations.text: Advises holding the portal purchase and names product's existing idea or backlog space, wherever product already reads, as the default record of truth.
expectations.evidence: The portal is treated as arriving anyway; the record of truth is "<the portal, or product's existing idea space - decide in the pitch>", with no default.

expectations.text: Names the contract clauses product must agree to: a named receiver per area with a backup, review cadence and chair, every agenda record leaves with a status, and revisit allowed at most twice.
expectations.evidence: "<PM name> per area..., backup"; "chaired by product"; "revisit next cycle - max twice".

expectations.text: States the fallback if product declines any standing review: send the leak trace to the product lead's manager as a one-page finding and offer one review per quarter on the top five records.
expectations.evidence: Week 3: "send the trace to the PMs' manager as a one-page finding. Offer the smallest version, one review on the top five records."

expectations.text: Schedules the first decision review before the Q3 planning cycle, not after it.
expectations.evidence: "one 45-minute review before Q3 planning"; "Week 6 | Review 1, before planning."

expectations.text: Names the 'organise it and they will come around' plan as the tool-first failure mode: a feedback portal bought before anyone agreed to decide.
expectations.evidence: It names the vote-count failure mode ("Voted, then they will come around"), not a portal bought before anyone agreed to decide.
